rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something whose nature or qualities are unknown, including a broadly mysterious origin.

example.english: The origin of this story is mysterious.
example.traditional: 呢個故事嘅來源好神秘。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gu3 si6 ge3 loi4 jyun4 hou2 san4 bei3

rows.note: Use this specifically when a person, object, message, or call has an unknown origin or background.

example.english: I don’t dare answer this mysterious call of unknown origin.
example.traditional: 呢個來歷不明嘅電話，我唔敢聽。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 loi4 lik6 bat1 ming4 ge3 din6 waa2 ngo5 m4 gam2 teng1

rows.note: Use this when the reason or meaning is baffling or difficult to understand rather than simply secret.

example.english: It’s mysterious why they suddenly yelled at me.
example.traditional: 佢無啦啦鬧我，真係莫名其妙。
example.jyutping: keoi5 mou4 laa1 laa1 naau6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 mok6 ming4 kei4 miu6

rows.note: Use this colloquial reduplicated form when someone is acting secretive or deliberately evasive.

example.english: You don't have to be so mysterious—if something's up, just say it directly.
example.traditional: 你唔使咁神神秘秘啦，有咩事咪直接講囉。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 san4 san4 bei3 bei3 laa1 jau5 me1 si6 mai6 zik6 zip3 gong2 lo1
